summary: Scott's statements frame the Gaza conflict in Israel-centric terms. On October 26, 2023, he expressed empathy for families in Israel in a statement drawing criticism for omitting Palestinian victims in Gaza. After three Palestinian students were shot in Burlington on November 28, 2023, he offered support to Vermont's Muslim community. At an October 18 press conference, he was asked to criticize Israel's Gaza evacuation strategy; the record documents his response but not its substance.
